questions.question: Dr. Amrani must train young dentists in tax management. What is the first piece of advice he should give them?
options: Taxation is a pillar of the practice's sustainability
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Taxation is a pillar of the practice's sustainability. Good tax management is essential for the survival of the business.' Dr. Bennani: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must create a dental management training center. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'The main objective is to train practitioner-managers capable of managing their practice.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will participate in the training.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must evaluate a young dentist's tax performance. Which measure is most important?
options: Compliance with deadlines and tax compliance
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Compliance with deadlines and tax compliance are the most important measures.' Dr. Bennani: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must manage a crisis: a practice has been subject to a tax audit adjustment. What is the priority?
options: Protect the practice and regularize the situation
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'The priority is to protect the practice and regularize the situation with the tax authorities.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will help you manage this crisis.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must train interns in tax risk management. What is the fundamental principle?
options: Tax risk management is a responsibility
Tax risk management is a constraint
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Tax risk management is a fundamental responsibility of the manager.' Dr. Bennani: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must create a guide to good tax practices. What is the main reference?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'The guide must be based on current tax legislation.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will contribute to this guide.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must train young dentists in tax communication. What is the key message?
options: Taxation is a practice management tool
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Taxation is a practice management tool. It must be understood to manage better.' Dr. Bennani: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must create a dental management research program. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Research in dental management aims to improve practice management practices.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will participate in the research.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must manage a reference practice in management. What is the pillar of excellence?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Excellence in management is based on rigor and tax compliance.' Dr. Bennani: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must evaluate the impact of taxation on public health. What is the role of taxation?
options: It is a lever for accessibility to care
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Taxation can be a lever to improve accessibility to dental care.' Dr. Amrani: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must train interns in management innovation. What current trend is important?
options: All of the above are correct
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Innovation in management concerns digitalization, predictive management, and tax optimization.' Dr. Bennani: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must create a management skills assessment system. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Assessment of management skills aims to improve practices.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will participate in the assessment.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must manage a tax conflict of interest. What is the right attitude?
options: Act in accordance with the law
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'The law is the guide for resolving tax conflicts of interest.' Dr. Bennani: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must write an article on the future of dental management. What trend should be highlighted?
options: Digital innovation in service of management
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'The future of management is based on digital innovation.' Dr. Amrani: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must create a quality label for practices in management. What are the main criteria?
options: Management rigor, tax compliance, and transparency
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Management rigor, tax compliance, and transparency are the fundamental criteria.' Dr. Bennani: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must give a farewell speech to the profession. What message should she leave?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'The profession needs management visionaries to ensure its sustainability.' Dr. Amrani: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must create a scholarship for dental management students. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Encouraging excellence in management is an investment for the future.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will support this initiative.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must pass on her management knowledge. What is the most effective method?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Personalized mentoring and practical cases are the most effective methods.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will get involved in mentoring.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must create a peer network for young managers. What is the objective?
options: Foster mutual support and experience sharing
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Mutual support and sharing are essential for young managers.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will support this network.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must write a conclusion to her book on dental management. What is the final sentence?
options: Management is the soul of the practice's sustainability
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Management is the soul of the practice's sustainability.' Dr. Amrani: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: Management values and an example to follow
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Management values and the example are the most beautiful legacy one can leave.' Dr. Bennani: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must train future management mentors. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission of management values
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission of management values.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will convey this message.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must write a letter to future dentists about management. What message should he convey?
options: Management is a fundamental pillar of the practice
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Management is a fundamental pillar of the practice.' Dr. Bennani: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must create an award for young dentist-managers. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Stimulating excellence in management is essential for the evolution of the profession.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will support this award.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani, after a life dedicated to management, receives national recognition. Dr. Bennani is by his side. What is Dr. Amrani's message to young dentists?
options: Management is the heart of the practice's sustainability
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani concludes: 'Management is the heart of the practice's sustainability. It gives meaning to our practice.' Dr. Bennani: 'I am proud of you.'
